title: Grateful Dead Live at Warfield Theater on 1982-02-17
lineage: Set 1: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) -> FLAC/16
source: Set 1: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) Set 2: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (Dolby C)

ai_review.summary: Bright, fairly clear soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1982 show highlighted by a smoking Eyes of the World and a fiery Scarlet > Fire jam.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its relentless energy, especially the second set where Eyes of the World, Wheel, Sugar Magnolia and an inspired Scarlet Begonias → Fire on the Mountain jam shine. The SBD source sounds brighter than average for the era but suffers from typical early‑80s tape quirks – limited bass, occasional cuts and a few tape‑flip glitches – yet remains listenable.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 4–5 stars and highlight strong musical moments, while recording comments note only modest technical flaws; the weighted combination yields a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Bright tonal balance, limited low‑end bass and occasional ‘hot’ vocals typical of early‑80s SBD tapes; tape flips caused a few cuts, but overall clarity is decent for the period.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set dominates with high‑jamming intensity; first set less discussed but not criticized, overall pacing keeps momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Noted pausing to appreciate Brent’s phrasing during the Scarlet > Fire jam, indicating attentive interplay.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (referred to as ‘Bobby’) delivers an unusual and compelling vocal/keyboard phrase in the Scarlet > Fire jam.
